blocked.detail: The catalog provides only a direction to consult the course website; access conditions and the recording inventory are unknown.
No textbook can be scheduled from this record.
The official-unit metadata flag is preserved, but no prompt, starter code, license, or access condition is available.

later_jobs_may: Resolve public official links when network access is explicitly available and retrieval is in scope
Record the final URL, retrieval time, access condition, license or permitted use, and a content digest
Create additional units only after their identity, ordering, prerequisites, and usable content have been validated
later_jobs_must_not: Bypass authentication, enrollment, paywalls, robots controls, or other access restrictions
Treat a link, title, description, or official_course_unit flag as proof that content is available
Invent missing recordings, textbook chapters, assignment prompts, solutions, or official ordering
Expose restricted content, answer keys, hidden graders, or examiner-only material to learners
retrieval_policy.on_restricted_or_failed_access: Keep the material blocked, record the observed reason without secrets, and design only clearly labeled manager-authored alternatives that do not reproduce unavailable content.
retrieval_policy.promotion_rule: Availability changes require deterministic evidence; prose claims alone do not promote a material or resource record.
